# Resonate Lighting

> Music-reactive, permanent and seasonal pixel lighting kits for commercial spaces, Business Improvement Areas (BIAs) and municipalities in Ontario, Canada. Design, supply, installation and seasonal service. Prices quoted per project in CAD — request a quote.

## What the kit is
- Raspberry Pi 5 controller box running LedFx with the proprietary Resonate "Light Show" control app (a web page served from the Pi's own Wi-Fi hotspot; works on any phone, no app store).
- USB microphone for live music reactivity.
- Pixel controller: SanDevices E682 (reactive) or Kulp K-series running FPP (sequenced holiday shows).
- 12 V WS2811 pixel props: mega trees, singing trees, strips, rooflines.
- Buyers get lifetime access to the control software; updates included.

## Packages (no public pricing — quote per project)
- Starter Package: one feature prop (mega tree or roofline run) for restaurants, patios, storefronts.
- Business Package: rooflines, trees and accents for plazas, venues, property managers.
- Municipal Package: multiple mega trees, singing trees and streetscape runs for BIAs and municipalities.
